complaint: Maine dukaan pe ₹2,400 ka UPI payment kiya, PhonePe pe “failed” aaya lekin account se paise kat gaye. Dukandar bolta hai use nahi mile. 3 din ho gaye.
complaint_en: I made a UPI payment of ₹2,400 at a shop, it showed "failed" on PhonePe but the money was deducted from my account. The shopkeeper says he did not receive it. It has been 3 days.
extra_questions: Bank ya PhonePe se aapko ab tak kya jawab mila hai?
domain_basis: top-2 result for “PhonePe official website”, brand match

facts.issue: The user made a UPI payment that failed on the app but was deducted from their bank account.

clauses.title: Grounds of Complaint
clauses.citation: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 9
clauses.text: 9. Grounds of Complaint Any customer aggrieved by an act or omission of a Bank resulting in deficiency in service may file a complaint under the Scheme personally or through an authorised representative as defined under clause 3(1)(c).
clauses.query: grounds of complaint act or omission of bank resulting in deficiency in service

clauses.title: Grounds for maintainability of a Complaint
clauses.citation: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 10(2)–(3)
clauses.text: (2) The complaints involving the following matters are excluded from the purview of the Scheme: (a) matters related to commercial judgment or decision of a Bank; (b) a dispute between a vendor and a Bank; (c) grievances against Management or Executives of a Bank; (d) a grievance arising from an action of a Bank in compliance with the orders of a judicial/quasi-judicial or statutory or law enforcing authority; (e) a service not within the regulatory purview of the Reserve Bank; (f) a dispute between Banks; (g) a dispute involving the employee-employer relationship of a Bank; (h) a grievance for which a remedy has been provided in Section 18 of the Credit Information Companies (Regulation) Act, 2005; and This is Public document. (i) a grievance pertaining to customers of Bank not included under the Scheme. (3) Complaints not meeting the eligibility conditions as specified under sub-clause (1) and complaints that are mentioned in sub-clause (2), shall be rejected at the outset as non-maintainable without further examination, with appropriate communication to the Complainant.

To,
Bank grievance cell → Principal Nodal Officer
PhonePe

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Grievance regarding failed UPI transaction - ₹2,400 - Reference ID: w442342

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to report a failed UPI transaction that occurred on 10 September. I attempted to make a payment of ₹2,400 via PhonePe. Although the application displayed a 'failed' status, the amount of ₹2,400 was successfully deducted from my bank account. The merchant has confirmed that they did not receive these funds. I have already reported this issue to the bank and PhonePe customer care, but the matter remains unresolved. This failure to credit the amount back to my account constitutes a deficiency in service under [C1]. I request you to investigate this transaction (Reference ID: w442342) and process the refund of ₹2,400 to my account immediately. Please note that if this grievance is not resolved within 30 days, I will be compelled to escalate this matter to the RBI Ombudsman under the Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, as per [C2]. I look forward to a prompt resolution by 8 November 2026.

Yours faithfully,
[YOUR NAME]
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
[ADDRESS]

Legal basis cited:
[C1] Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 9 — Grounds of Complaint
[C2] Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 10(2)–(3) — Grounds for maintainability of a Complaint

Aapka UPI payment fail hone ke baad bhi paise account se kat gaye hain. Maine bank ko complaint letter likha hai taaki aapka ₹2,400 ka refund jaldi mil sake. Agar 30 din mein bank jawab nahi deta, toh aap RBI Ombudsman ke paas ja sakte hain.

```
To,
Bank grievance cell → Principal Nodal Officer
PhonePe

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Grievance regarding failed UPI transaction - ₹2,400 - Reference ID: w442342

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to report a failed UPI transaction that occurred on 10 September. I attempted to make a payment of ₹2,400 via PhonePe. Although the application displayed a 'failed' status, the amount of ₹2,400 was successfully deducted from my bank account. The merchant has confirmed that they did not receive these funds. I have already reported this issue to the bank and PhonePe customer care, but the matter remains unresolved. This failure to credit the amount back to my account constitutes a deficiency in service under [C1]. I request you to investigate this transaction (Reference ID: w442342) and process the refund of ₹2,400 to my account immediately. Please note that if this grievance is not resolved within 30 days, I will be compelled to escalate this matter to the RBI Ombudsman under the Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, as per [C2]. I look forward to a prompt resolution by 8 November 2026.

Yours faithfully,
[YOUR NAME]
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
[ADDRESS]

Legal basis cited:
[C1] Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 9 — Grounds of Complaint
[C2] Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 10(2)–(3) — Grounds for maintainability of a Complaint
```

## If there's no reply
**Reply due by 8 November 2026** — if the bank does not reply within 30 days of receiving your complaint, you can go to the RBI Ombudsman (Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 10(1)).

1. **Bank grievance cell → Principal Nodal Officer** (email / bank complaint portal) — First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint number; escalate to the Principal Nodal Officer if unresolved.
   📅 reply due by 8 November 2026
2. **RBI Ombudsman (RB-IOS, 2026)** (RBI CMS portal / email) — No reply within 30 days, or the reply is unsatisfactory. Also crpc@rbi.org.in. No fee. https://cms.rbi.org.in · 14448 (RBI contact centre)
   📅 you can go here from 8 November 2026 if unresolved
3. **District Consumer Commission** (online filing (e-Jagriti)) — Deficiency in banking service is also a consumer dispute. https://e-jagriti.gov.in
   📅 you can go here from 8 November 2026 if unresolved · last date to file: 10 September 2028

_Information, not legal advice._
